To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the integration of palliate care in the care of cancer patients is possible and necessary, and that a needs-based structuring of the care system can be achieved with the use of specific tools.

the demand-oriented structuring and the implementation of palliative care requires a clear and consistent definition of the term "palliative care", an integrated approach in routine processes of care, an evidence-based needs assessment and a demand-orientated supply of services.

palliative care should not be considered as a separate care approach but rather be integrated in the routine care of patients with incurable, progressive diseases, and in particular cancer, in the last period of their life.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of concepts to structure palliative care in a demand-oriented way in the German health system.
a demand-oriented structuration of palliative care.
an evidence-based and demand-oriented structuring and further development of the health care system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
palliative care is not sufficiently integrated in the care processes for cancer patients.
the current situation of care for cancer patients at the end of their life is characterized by a lack of integration of palliative aspects and a lack of integration in the care process.
the integration of pallative care in the care process of cancer patients is an urgent task for the health care system in Germany and should be a priority in the health care policy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the demand-oriented structuring and integration of palliative services in Lower Saxony is a necessary precondition to improve the situation of palliative patients.

the integration of pallitative care in the German health system requires a clear definition of the care concept as well as a clear definition of responsibilities and a systematic integration in the care processes.

a demand-oriented development of palliative care is only possible if the needs of patients and relatives are considered and integrated in the health care system, if a clear definition of palliative care exists and if the concept is integrated in the health system.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a demand-oriented development of palliative care can be achieved by a systematic analysis of current structures and a consequent integration into the health care system, which is in line with the principles of the German Health Care Reform Act.
the development of palliative care should not be left solely to the initiative of single institutions and providers but should be supported by the state and health care policy.
the development of palliative care requires a holistic approach, including structural, cultural and contents-related aspects.
